blurb: Hurricane Marina offers boat rentals including tritoons, pontoons, double decker pontoons, runabouts, wave runners, ski boats, kayaks, and paddle boards. The marina features a state-of-the-art facility with 24-hour fuel stations, a restaurant, a fully stocked ship store, and golf cart valet service. It is located 3 miles south of Interstate 40 in a natural harbor on Center Hill Lake.

quotes.author: Laura A
quotes.text: We'd just finished hiking Window Cliffs and happened upon Hurricane Marina and the Blue Water Grill as we were doing some scenic driving around the lake. Love the ambiance. We hope to be back again this season. Our late lunch topped off a beautiful day.

quotes.author: Jennifer J
quotes.text: Hurricane is the best marina on Center Hill Lake! Great folks and great service, like family! Thanks for always going out of your way to make sure we have the best day! So happy we chose Hurricane.

quotes.author: Paula D
quotes.text: Our home away from home complete with our lake family. Hurricane Marina is simply the best.
